# Kodra — Full Documentation for LLMs

> One-command Azure developer environment for Ubuntu Desktop, WSL2 & macOS. Built by [Code To Cloud Inc.](https://www.codetocloud.io)

## Overview

Kodra is an opinionated developer setup for engineers who build and deploy on Azure with GitHub CLI and AI agentic workflows. It transforms a vanilla Ubuntu 24.04+ install, WSL2, or macOS (Apple Silicon / Intel) into a beautiful, productive cloud-native development workstation in under 5 minutes. The unified website at kodra.codetocloud.io serves Ubuntu Desktop, WSL2, and macOS audiences with a platform toggle.

GitHub CLI (`gh`) is the backbone of Kodra's agentic development experience. Combined with Copilot CLI, you can ask questions, generate code, create PRs, and manage repos—all from your terminal.

## Installation

### Ubuntu Desktop
```bash
wget -qO- https://kodra.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

### WSL2 (Windows)
```bash
wget -qO- https://kodra.wsl.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

### macOS (Apple Silicon)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://kodra.macos.codetocloud.io/boot.sh | bash
```

### Customized install
```bash
KODRA_SKIP="spotify,discord" ./install.sh
KODRA_THEME="ghostty-blue" ./install.sh
KODRA_MINIMAL=1 ./install.sh
./install.sh --debug
```

## Why Ubuntu?

- **Massive Community**: 40M+ users, endless tutorials, instant answers
- **Lower Learning Curve**: Most beginner-friendly Linux distro
- **Azure Native Support**: First-class support in Azure VMs, WSL, and all major cloud tools
- **LTS Stability**: 5 years of security updates

## Why macOS?

- **Homebrew Native**: Every tool installed through Homebrew or native .pkg installers
- **Docker or Podman**: Choose Colima + Docker CLI or Podman stack — both license-free, no Docker Desktop
- **Apple Silicon**: ARM-native builds for all tools, no Rosetta overhead (Intel also supported)
- **macOS Defaults**: Sensible Dock, Finder, keyboard tweaks, and dark mode
- **Ansible**: Red Hat Ansible pre-installed for infrastructure automation

## All Commands

```bash
kodra theme       # Switch themes (tokyo-night, ghostty-blue, catppuccin, gruvbox, nord, rose-pine)
kodra wallpaper   # Browse and set wallpapers
kodra desktop     # Configure dock, tiling, login screen
kodra repair      # Re-apply all configs without reinstalling
kodra dock        # Set dock favorites
kodra motd        # Set terminal banner (banner, minimal, none)
kodra setup       # Initialize user config (first-time or re-run GitHub, Azure login)
kodra fetch       # Show system info (beautiful fastfetch)
kodra doctor      # Check system health
kodra update      # Update everything
kodra dev         # Install language runtimes (node, python, go...)
kodra db          # Start database containers (postgres, mysql, redis...)
kodra install     # Install additional applications
kodra uninstall   # Remove applications
kodra backup      # Backup/export dotfiles and settings
kodra restore     # Restore backed up dotfiles
kodra resume      # Resume incomplete installation
kodra cleanup     # Clear system caches and free space
kodra refresh     # Hot-reload theme components
kodra extensions  # Manage GNOME extensions
kodra power       # Set power profile (performance/balanced/power-saver)
kodra nightlight  # Toggle night light (blue light filter)
kodra font        # Change terminal font
kodra screenshot  # Take screenshots (full/region/window)
kodra shortcuts   # Display keyboard shortcuts
kodra menu        # Interactive main menu
```

## Themes

Six themes that sync across terminal, editor, and desktop:

| Theme | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| Tokyo Night | Purple-blue Tokyo city lights (default) |
| Ghostty Blue | Deep navy with electric cyan |
| Catppuccin | Warm pastel colorscheme |
| Gruvbox | Retro earthy warm tones |
| Nord | Arctic cool blue palette |
| Rosé Pine | Warm and elegant muted tones |

## Keyboard Shortcuts

### Desktop
| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| Super + Space | App launcher (ULauncher) |
| Super + Return | Open terminal |
| Super + T | Window tiling grid |
| Super + ←/→ | Tile left/right half |
| Shift + Super + 3/4/5 | Screenshots (macOS-style) |

### Shell Aliases
| Alias | Action |
|-------|--------|
| `??` | Ask GitHub Copilot for shell commands |
| `ghpr` | Create a PR via GitHub CLI |
| `lg` | Launch lazygit |
| `lzd` | Launch lazydocker |
| `gs`, `ga`, `gc`, `gp` | Git shortcuts |
| `azd-up` | Deploy to Azure |
| `tf`, `tfi`, `tfp`, `tfa` | Terraform shortcuts |

## Multi-User / System-Wide

```bash
# Install for all users (admin)
sudo bash install/system-wide.sh

# Each user initializes their config
kodra setup
```

## Architecture

```
kodra/
├── bin/kodra              # Main CLI dispatcher
├── bin/kodra-sub/         # Subcommands
├── configs/               # Shell, terminal, tmux configs
├── install/               # Installation scripts
│   ├── required/          # Core (always runs)
│   ├── desktop/           # GNOME setup
│   └── terminal/          # Terminal tools
├── lib/                   # Shared libraries (ui, utils, state)
├── themes/                # Theme definitions
├── wallpapers/            # Theme wallpapers
└── applications/          # Optional app installers
```

## Uninstall

```bash
bash ~/.kodra/uninstall.sh
```

## Requirements

- Ubuntu 24.04+, WSL2 (Windows 11), or macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon recommended, Intel supported)
- Internet connection for package installation
- ~2GB disk space for all tools
